description: Arsenal Mesh registry: machine-readable map of the user's runtime topology. Four node types (container/program/network/credential); edges describe how they connect. Each match run references node ids from here.

mesh_version.description: Must match data/mesh-version.json version this snapshot was taken against.

nodes.description: All known nodes. Credential nodes carry NAMES only, never values.

attrs.description: Free-form attributes: tier, ip, status, note, migration plan, etc.

type.description: container = runs things (T0/T1 own hardware, T2 someone else's infra). program = runs on containers. network = links/paths. credential = auth material (name only).

title: Arsenal Mesh registry
